**Status:** awaiting engineer approval (the ONE approval, OC-13)

## Original description

> I want a simple to-do app to track daily tasks

## Platform

web browser (local-first, no account, no backend)

## Stack

React + Vite + TypeScript; Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom)

## Features

- add task
- list tasks
- complete task
- delete task
- filter view

## Acceptance criteria (per feature)

- **add task:** Enter or Add submits; empty/whitespace-only rejected (no task, input keeps focus); new task appears at top immediately; persists across reload
- **list tasks:** newest-first by createdAt (stable for ties); live total count; friendly empty-state message when none; survives reload
- **complete task:** checkbox toggles completed; completed title shows strikethrough; persists; double-toggle restores original; storage failure reverts + accessible error (no silent unsaved state)
- **delete task:** per-task delete control; removes from list + store; persists; deleting the last task returns to empty state; storage failure keeps the row + accessible error
- **filter view:** All / Active / Completed buttons (aria-pressed); visible list + count reflect the filtered set; selection persists across reload; switching never writes task data; invalid/unreadable stored filter falls back to All; per-filter empty message

## Data model

Task { id: string (crypto.randomUUID), title: string (non-empty, trimmed), completed: boolean, createdAt: number (ms epoch, for newest-first ordering) }

## Persistence

localStorage, single JSON key 'todo-demo:tasks'; on write failure keep the draft, show an accessible error, commit nothing; on read failure/corruption render the empty state (no crash)

## Look and feel

clean warm paper theme; light + dark; minimal, calm density

## Assumptions & resolved ambiguities

'daily' is interpreted as 'an app used daily', NOT tasks with daily recurrence/reset. Daily reset, due dates, and recurrence are OUT of scope for this version. No accounts, no cloud sync, no categories, no drag-to-reorder, no undo.
